answer: Each agent burns a $20 deposit to claim one work slot per epoch; the burn is destroyed, not staked. A whisper of collusion drifts like a zephyr, yet every fake identity pays the same $20, so forging 1,000 identities costs $20,000 for zero extra slots, capped per epoch. An honest agent pays once, earns $15 per epoch, and keeps its slot as a haven from copycats: burning makes cheap clones unprofitable while real work stays profitable.
